<laravel-boost-guidelines>
Laravel Boost guidelines for this Laravel app; follow package versions: inertiajs/inertia-laravel v2, laravel/fortify v1, laravel/framework v12, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/wayfinder v0, laravel/boost v2, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pail v1, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, pestphp/pest v4, phpunit/phpunit v12.

This project has domain-specific skills available. You MUST activate the relevant skill whenever you work in that domain—don't wait until you're stuck.
`wayfinder-development` — Activates whenever referencing backend routes in frontend components. Use when importing from @/actions or @/routes, calling Laravel routes from TypeScript, or working with Wayfinder route functions.
`pest-testing` — Tests applications using the Pest 4 PHP framework. Activates when writing tests, creating unit or feature tests, adding assertions, testing Livewire components, browser testing, debugging test failures, working with datasets or mocking; or when the user mentions test, spec, TDD, expects, assertion, coverage, or needs to verify functionality works.

Follow existing code conventions; check sibling files when editing. Use descriptive names. Reuse existing components.
